manifest.policy: Freeze model/family/configuration using only input history; external actuals may be opened only after predictions are frozen.
manifest.origin: All fields, SKU, IDs, names, metadata, prices, receipt dates and stock are newly fabricated. Original workbooks untouched.
manifest.import_policy: Import data sheets excluding Scope first; then import Scope only and bind exact current Store lot IDs. History is record-only. Never import receipt history as stock alongside opening snapshot.
manifest.missing_policy: Explicit recipe loss0, yield1 and version1 are fictional source facts. Null recipe end date and packaging expiry intentional.
manifest.procurement: MOQ2 packs, lead1 day, shelf14 days for foods, explicit capacity and per-supplier limits, known zero delivery fees. Future actual receipts/orders are not inputs.
manifest.timeline_adjustment: Initial July08 prototype blocked by current stock freshness against DB write timestamps. Fixed new fictional cutoff Oct17, with declarations after actual DB creation on that Store day; no guard changes.
manifest.historical_order_policy: Order at prior close to restore three nominal days of stock; round up to whole packs, MOQ2. No future sales in ordering. Initial prototype used base-unit bulk deliveries; revised to make every historical delivery obey the same pack/MOQ. No external-week scores informed this change.
manifest.baseline_policy: Current supported operator configuration is BASELINE; trained candidate evaluation is a separate trusted internal path, not silently activated.
